how: Every edit Joel gives goes in here the same turn, with his words and the strings the guide must (or must not) contain once it's done. Status pending until the guide has it; then applied.
tools/humanization/check_owner_edits.py checks every entry against GUIDE-SO-FAR.md; render_article_so_far.py runs it on every render.
His words of 2026-11-03 18:59 UTC are in experiments/t01-answers/JOEL-MESSAGE-20261103-1859.md.

entries.what: RP-4 his way: the hierarchy's last paragraph goes, his line stays in his words
entries.joel: 18:59: "rp-4 approve yes i want to keep the gut driven mental hell line altho i'd change it to sound more human: \"A gut-driven mental hell is often mistaken as shadow work\""
must_contain: A gut-driven mental hell is often mistaken as shadow work.
must_not_contain: A gut-driven mental hell is not automatically shadow work

entries.what: Q-1 (a): the Core Order's first step says to smell humic acid first
entries.joel: 18:59: "q-1 smell it first for sure, that's like an allergy test"
must_contain: Smell humic acid first; if that doesn't help, take a 5mg lick of it.
must_not_contain: Smell humic acid, take a 5mg lick of it.

entries.what: Q-4 (a): the lengths stay; Alone at 3 a.m. quotes the note as it is
Q-5 (a): room before body in all four places
must_contain: Then return to room, body, human, time, and love.

must_not_contain: Charcoal belongs only in the separate recent-oral-ingestion branch.
No entity, deity, demon, ancestor, angel, algorithm, mission, kundalini surge, or insight overrides basic safety.

entries.what: ST-1 A: the checklist keeps each step's heading and one or two of his lines with a link; the Longer Triage goes
entries.waits_for: round 2's page (review/r02), cards CL-1 to CL-15 and LT-1 to LT-5
must_not_contain: The Longer Triage: What Kind of Trouble Is This?

entries.what: Q-3: DMSO with harmalas, in his words
entries.joel: 18:59: "don't put the harmala in the dmso or take them exactly at the same time, but it's totally fine to take them a bit apart"
entries.waits_for: his OK on round 2's card AN-Q3a
must_contain: don't put the harmala in the DMSO or take them at exactly the same time

entries.what: Q-3: a possible bleed, in his words
entries.joel: 18:59: "if someone is worried about a bleed, i'd prob skip dmso but it depends on how severe their issue is"
entries.waits_for: his OK on round 2's card AN-Q3b
must_contain: If someone is worried about a bleed, I'd probably skip DMSO

entries.what: Q-6 (b): how ocean water and charcoal water differ, in his words
entries.joel: 18:59: "i feel like the ocean water can reduce the intesnity of the trip a bit more than the ozonated charcoal water"
entries.waits_for: his OK on round 2's card AN-Q6
must_not_contain: These work similarly to ocean water.

entries.what: Q-1: try the remedies in low, increasing doses before a crisis, in his words
entries.joel: 18:59: "in general it's good to try all these things in very low, increasing doses before they are needed in crisis."
entries.waits_for: his OK on round 2's card AN-Q1
must_contain: try all these things in very low, increasing doses before they are needed in crisis
